CustomField.description: If true, an email is sent to Notification_Emails__c, from Org_Wide_Email_Address_Id__c, when this job ultimately finishes with errors (after any configured retries are exhausted). Both of those fields are required whenever this is checked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Send an email to Notification Emails if this job ultimately fails.
CustomField.label: Send Email On Failure
